record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Can one prove that every static black-hole solution of the Einstein-Yang-Mills equations is Reissner-Nordstrom?

evidence.quote: (vi) show that a static black hole solution of EYM must be Reissner-Nordstr!llm (An EYM black hole has no YM hair [YP;GE]).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Einstein–Yang–Mills (EYM) system on a 4-dimensional Lorentzian spacetime (M,g), consisting of a metric g and a connection A on a principal bundle with compact, semi-simple gauge group G (e.g. SU(2)), with curvature 2-form F. The field equations are
  Ric(g) − (1/2) R(g) g = 8π T(F),  d⋆F + [A,⋆F] = 0,
where T(F) is the Yang–Mills stress–energy tensor.

A black-hole solution is an asymptotically flat, regular solution of these equations possessing a non-empty event horizon. The solution is called static if (M,g) admits a Killing vector field that is timelike near spatial infinity and orthogonal to a family of spacelike hypersurfaces, and if A is invariant under the corresponding flow.

The Reissner–Nordström family consists of the spherically symmetric solutions with an Abelian (Coulombic) Yang–Mills field, i.e. F valued in a fixed Cartan subalgebra and given by an electric/magnetic monopole on each Lie-algebra direction, with metric
  g = −(1 − 2M/r + Q²/r²) dt² + (1 − 2M/r + Q²/r²)⁻¹ dr² + r² dΩ²,
for constants M and Q.

Problem. Prove or disprove: every static, asymptotically flat black-hole solution of the Einstein–Yang–Mills equations is gauge-equivalent to a Reissner–Nordström solution.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjectured statement is now known to be false in the non-Abelian setting: Bartnik–McKinnon solitons (1988) and the subsequent "colored black holes" of Bizoń, Künzle–Masood-ul-Alam, and Volkov–Gal'tsov provide explicit static, asymptotically flat, spherically symmetric black-hole solutions of the SU(2) Einstein–Yang–Mills equations that are not Reissner–Nordström, thereby violating the no-hair conjecture for EYM. These hairy black holes are typically unstable, but exist as genuine static solutions, so the proposed uniqueness statement does not hold as stated.

status_evidence.title: Reissner–Nordström black holes with non-Abelian hair
status_evidence.snippet: Colored black holes in SU(2) EYM theory are asymptotically flat with screened global YM charge; for a given mass there are infinitely many distinct solutions, violating no-hair.
status_evidence.claim: Static non-Reissner–Nordström (colored) black-hole solutions of EYM exist, refuting the proposed uniqueness.

status_evidence.title: Stability of Einstein Yang-Mills black holes
status_evidence.snippet: Analysis of stability of static non-Abelian EYM (colored) black-hole solutions.
status_evidence.claim: Static non-Abelian EYM black holes distinct from Reissner–Nordström have been constructed and studied.
